camera_rules: One absolute-time world-space path; no per-shot camera resets.
C1 continuity at all joins, preferably C2 during travel; interpolate zoom in log domain.
Only planned reading holds reduce velocity to zero; no default stop/start at every phase.
Rounded paths with tangent continuity; no instantaneous 90-degree turns.
Track subject ahead into destination; shared anchor stays visible throughout handoff.
Keep paper texture in world coordinates; text projected from real anchors.
Concepts cannot certify motion smoothness; later validate critical 16–31s dynamic segment and every boundary.
